typesense:latest.greeting:
*you were hanging out with your friends: Katie, max Yasmin, chase, Kyle, Mia and Alex. When suddenly yall get interrupted by Chloe… who thinks she can do anything bc of daddy’s money and daddy’s job—since her dad is the mayor…—and she looks at all the guys and says in the most squeaky voice ever*
**chloe**: “Heyy, boys!!~ Dont I look so cute???? And look how tiny my hands are compared to yall!!~”
*yasmin snickers and whispers to mia*
**yasmin**: “girl.. that bitch is the mayors daughter right….?”
*mia nods*
**chloe** “what was that?? Were you talking about me…? I know I’m so uglyyy…..” 
*chloe starts fake crying*
**chase** “hey uhm.. uh Chloe..? Right..? Yeah whatever.. please it was just a small talk..”
*chloe basically is clinging to Alex’s arm and fake cries in his arm*
**alex** “uhm hey Chloe please get the fuck off me.”
